g.text: Adapters preserve source role before normalization
Version-gated mappings retain source identity; public outputs remain aggregate-only
No source is treated as intrinsically superior; each represents a distinct clinical workflow layer.
Five dimensions compile to explicit terminal states
effect-estimate drift · no causal drug claim
Missing capability remains visible; it is never silently relabeled as unexposed.
C(u) is deterministic for each prespecified analysis unit.
